title: Monkey in the Middle Passing Game
description: A classic passing game: one defender in the middle tries to intercept or deflect passes between three or four players on the outside.

content.objective: Move the ball quickly and read passing lanes to avoid a defender in the middle.
content.setup: Three or four passers form a circle around one defender in the middle.
instructions: Passers move the ball around the circle, using fakes to confuse the defender.
The defender tries to deflect or intercept any pass.
Whoever threw a pass that gets intercepted becomes the next defender.
Add a two-pass-maximum hold rule to speed up decisions once the group is comfortable.
coachingPoints: Use pass fakes to move the defender before the real pass.
Pass away from the defender's side whenever possible.
Move slightly after every catch to open new angles.
commonMistakes: Standing still in the same spot the whole game.
Holding the ball too long deciding where to pass.
Passing from a standstill instead of stepping into it.
content.safety: The defender may only reach for the ball, not grab a passer's arms.
